name: Earth
description: The Earth play style generates the real Earth: Copernicus GLO-90 heights, real rivers, streams, lakes and coasts as of 1318, climate and weather, soil from the real soil map, the game's rock layers or the real rock regions, and trees, plants and animals as around 1318. One mod: the first time, the server downloads Earth's data from GitHub (about 300 MB, 58 MB more of monthly temperatures and 21 MB of soil for new worlds, and 45 MB more of the rock map for worlds with regional rock, once per machine) and, as a world needs them, the GLO-90 heights (8.6 GB by default, with about 190 MB of lake, river and dam files beside them, and 65 MB of streams for 1:25 and 1:10 worlds). Needs Cylinder World (the world wraps east-west, its walls are the poles) and Hydrology. Supports Floral Zones, Wildcraft Trees, Fauna of the Stone Age and Geology Additions.
